component.name: PingDub
component.summary: Lossless analog video capture with correct timing

description.p: PingDub captures composite and S-video from analog capture devices and writes the untouched video and audio stream to disk, with every frame accounted for and audio in sync at the end of a six-hour tape. It is modeled on the capture mode of VirtualDub, rewritten for Linux.

Output is FFV1 and PCM in Matroska by default, tagged with field order, pixel aspect and color so HandBrake reads them with no manual settings. Dropped and inserted frames, xruns, clock drift and signal changes are on screen during capture and logged afterward.
